title: SPENT ENTIRE PAYCHECK AT EPCOT FOOD AND WINE 2018 | Walt Disney World Vlog
description:
We spent all of our money at Walt Disney World's EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival 2018!We enjoyed Remy's Ratatouille Hide & Squeak scavenger hunt around the world showcase. We had amazing drinks in the Light Lab before trying food at our favorite booths.
